question: Metal fixings cover 1% of an insulated wall and pass 25 times more heat per square metre. By what percentage does total heat loss rise?
move: A sliver of the area can carry a large share of the flow.
trap: Expecting about 1% more, since the metal covers 1% of the area.
hint: Weight each part of the wall by its area and by the heat it lets through.
steps: Call the insulated wall's loss 1 unit per square metre.
99% of the area at 1 unit gives 0.99; 1% at 25 units gives 0.25.
reference: ISO 6946:2017, Building components and building elements — Thermal resistance and thermal transmittance — Calculation methods
